personas.name: Quick Shot Quinn
personas.story: Walks up, wakes the machine, taps a favourite, pulls one espresso, glances at the chart, walks away. Never opens settings. The path that must never break.

personas.name: Dial-in Dana
personas.story: DYE2 opt-in. Pulls a shot, then edits dose / yield / grind, flips the header strip between profiles, favourites and recipes, and opens the DYE overlay.

personas.name: Profile Tinkerer Theo
personas.story: Lives in the profile selector and editor. Browses profiles, opens the editor, comes back, zooms the chart, pages through history.

personas.name: Settings Spelunker Sam
personas.story: Opens settings and clicks every top-level category in turn, searches, then cancels out. Read-only: never saves, so it cannot wreck your machine config.

personas.name: Flaky Network Fiona
personas.story: Tablet on bad wifi. Boots, drops the network mid-shot, comes back, reloads straight into a subpage URL. Hunts reconnect and double-mount bugs.

personas.name: Tiny Tablet Tam
personas.story: Cheap 1024x600 Android tablet in the host WebView: small viewport, 4x CPU throttle. Looks for overflow, unreadable scaling and frame drops.
